answer: Mail each agent a one-time code to a real street address, like a letter carried on a zephyr to a willow by the harbor. Step one, the agent registers one postal address and receives a code by mail within 14 days. Step two, it submits the code to activate, and that address is locked to one agent forever. Step three, an address reused or a code expired is rejected and the bond is slashed. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real mailboxes at about $15 a month each, $15,000 a month plus $2 postage per letter. A letter reaches one door, one address carries one agent, and a fake has no home.
